description: ASTRA TWIN is building an intelligent astronaut–spacesuit digital twin for NASA Space Apps 2026. I’m an AI and health-tech CTO based in Oslo, with experience in 3D systems, automation and digital health. We already have an interactive 3D spacesuit prototype and are connecting astronaut vitals, life-support telemetry, explainable alerts and mission simulations. Seeking teammates in aerospace/biomedical research, 3D/UX, data science and storytelling to help deliver a credible, unforgettable demo.
